sources: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2025 (https://www.ibm.com/reports/data-breach)
_meta.methodology: meanCostPerRecord below is IBM 2025's global per-record cost broken down BY DATA TYPE (Figure 6: intellectual property $178, employee PII $168, customer PII $160, other corporate data $154, anonymized customer data $115) — IBM does not publish per-record cost by industry. Each industry entry uses the data type its breaches most commonly expose (e.g. Healthcare/Financial → customer PII; Technology → intellectual property). regulatoryMultipliers remain illustrative estimates, not independently sourced per framework.
_meta.note: Educational model — values represent published industry averages and are not a substitute for actuarial certification.
_meta.supersedes: Previous version used industry-specific per-record figures (e.g. Healthcare $499/record) sourced to pre-2023 methodology no longer published by IBM. Refreshed 2026-07 to the single IBM 2025 by-data-type table to remove an unsourced, drifted per-industry figure.
